mapper.insert: insert into team_match ( title, content, user_id, team_id, created_at, match_date, sport, start_time, end_time, place_name, address, latitude, longitude, participation_fee, fee, deadline, skill_intro, skill_beginner, skill_intermediate, skill_advanced, age_20s, age_30s, age_40s, age_50s, age_60_plus, gender, match_people, deleted, image1, image2, image3, image4, image5, status, region ) values ( #{title}, #{content}, #{userId}, #{teamId}, now(), #{matchDate}, #{sport}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{placeName}, #{address}, #{latitude}, #{longitude}, #{participationFee}, #{fee}, #{deadline}, #{skillIntro}, #{skillBeginner}, #{skillIntermediate}, #{skillAdvanced}, #{age20s}, #{age30s}, #{age40s}, #{age50s}, #{age60Plus}, #{gender}, #{matchPeople}, false, #{image1}, #{image2}, #{image3}, #{image4}, #{image5}, '모집중', #{region} )
mapper.select: select count(*) from team_match where status = '종료'

select tm.team_match_id, tm.title, tm.content, tm.user_id, tm.team_id, tm.created_at, tm.match_date, tm.sport, tm.start_time, tm.end_time, tm.place_name, tm.address, tm.latitude, tm.longitude, tm.participation_fee, tm.fee, tm.deadline, tm.skill_intro, tm.skill_beginner, tm.skill_intermediate, tm.skill_advanced, tm.age_20s, tm.age_30s, tm.age_40s, tm.age_50s, tm.age_60_plus, tm.gender, tm.match_people, tm.image1, tm.image2, tm.image3, tm.image4, tm.image5, tm.status, tm.region, t.team_name as team_name, u.nickname as host_nickname, u.profile_image as host_profile_image, u.bio as host_bio, u.preferred_region1 as host_region1, u.preferred_region2 as host_region2, u.preferred_region3 as host_region3, tu.team_role as host_role, case tm.sport when '축구/풋살' then u.soccer_skill when '농구' then u.basketball_skill when '테니스' then u.tennis_skill when '배드민턴' then u.badminton_skill end as host_skill, (select round(avg(r.score), 1) from user_rating r where r.receiver_user_id = tm.user_id) as host_rating, (select count(*) from user_rating r where r.receiver_user_id = tm.user_id) as host_rating_count, (select round(avg(tr.score), 1) from team_rating tr where tr.team_id = tm.team_id) as team_rating, (select count(*) from team_rating tr where tr.team_id = tm.team_id) as team_rating_count, (select count(*) > 0 from favorite f where f.user_id = #{userId} and f.match_type = 'Team' and f.match_id = tm.team_match_id) as favorite from team_match tm join team t on t.team_id = tm.team_id join user u on u.user_id = tm.user_id left join team_user tu on tu.team_id = tm.team_id and tu.user_id = tm.user_id and tu.withdrawn = 0 where tm.team_match_id = #{teamMatchId} and coalesce(tm.deleted, 0) = 0

select tm.team_match_id, tm.title, tm.content, tm.user_id, tm.team_id, tm.created_at, tm.match_date, tm.sport, tm.start_time, tm.end_time, tm.place_name, tm.address, tm.latitude, tm.longitude, tm.participation_fee, tm.fee, tm.deadline, tm.skill_intro, tm.skill_beginner, tm.skill_intermediate, tm.skill_advanced, tm.age_20s, tm.age_30s, tm.age_40s, tm.age_50s, tm.age_60_plus, tm.gender, tm.match_people, tm.image1, tm.image2, tm.image3, tm.image4, tm.image5, tm.status, tm.region, t.team_name as team_name, u.nickname as host_nickname, u.profile_image as host_profile_image, u.bio as host_bio, u.preferred_region1 as host_region1, u.preferred_region2 as host_region2, u.preferred_region3 as host_region3, tu.team_role as host_role, case tm.sport when '축구/풋살' then u.soccer_skill when '농구' then u.basketball_skill when '테니스' then u.tennis_skill when '배드민턴' then u.badminton_skill end as host_skill, (select round(avg(r.score), 1) from user_rating r where r.receiver_user_id = tm.user_id) as host_rating, (select count(*) from user_rating r where r.receiver_user_id = tm.user_id) as host_rating_count, (select round(avg(tr.score), 1) from team_rating tr where tr.team_id = tm.team_id) as team_rating, (select count(*) from team_rating tr where tr.team_id = tm.team_id) as team_rating_count from team_match tm join team t on t.team_id = tm.team_id join user u on u.user_id = tm.user_id left join team_user tu on tu.team_id = tm.team_id and tu.user_id = tm.user_id and tu.withdrawn = 0 where tm.team_match_id = #{teamMatchId} and coalesce(tm.deleted, 0) = 0
select team_match_id, team_id, user_id, title from team_match where status = '모집중' and deadline <= now() and coalesce(deleted, 0) = 0
mapper.update: update team_match set status = '인원 미달 경기 취소' where team_match_id = #{teamMatchId} and status = '모집중' and coalesce(deleted, 0) = 0
